name: Investing Agent
tagline: Scores one software stock at a time and hands you a buy-or-pass verdict
description: Takes a single publicly traded software company per pass, reads its fundamentals, and comes back with a scored verdict to buy or pass. Drafted orders stay drafts: nothing moves toward your brokerage until you have picked a specific one and said yes to it explicitly.
author: VijarKohli
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
